protocol.doc_text: '{title}\n\n{abstract}' if title else abstract; text is self-contained -- do NOT re-prepend the title column
protocol.candidate_pairs: exactly one curated PMID with a local abstract (the gold), PubTator-tagged with the query gene and cited by curators for <10 genes; disease id prefix in ['MONDO_', 'Orphanet_', 'EFO_'] (no HP phenotypes); gene not used by ['GeneDiseaseHaystack', 'GeneDiseaseHaystackDev', 'GeneDiseaseRetrieval']
protocol.same_gene: curated PMID for the query gene with a disease not related to d, PubTator-tagged with the query gene; its title/abstract does not contain the name or an OT exact synonym (>= 5 chars) of d or a twin of d
protocol.same_disease: curated PMID for the query disease with another gene, not PubTator-tagged with the query gene and not linked to it by any OT evidence (any disease)
protocol.related: related(d, o) if (ontology) o is reachable from d by same-concept links plus ancestor steps only, or plus descendant steps only (same concept = a shared dbXRef with prefix in ['DOID', 'EFO', 'GARD', 'HP', 'MEDDRA', 'MEDGEN', 'MESH', 'MONDO', 'MP', 'MedDRA', 'NANDO', 'NCIT', 'NCIt', 'OMIM', 'OMIMPS', 'Orphanet', 'SCTID', 'SNOMEDCT', 'SNOMEDCT_US', 'UMLS', 'icd11.foundation'], or one's id among the other's dbXRefs); or (category) o is in the OT family, or a twin of it, of a disease sharing a classification code ['ICD-10', 'ICD10', 'ICD10CM', 'ICD10WHO', 'ICD9', 'ICDO'] with d or a twin; or (names) each stemmed name word of one, minus modifiers and numbers, is inside a name word of the other; or o is not in the OT disease index
protocol.guard: no corpus doc is linked (curated or silver_links) to any query's gene with a disease related to the query disease unless it is that query's gold; asserted for every (query, doc, linked disease)
protocol.selection: seeded shuffle (seed 46) of 640 candidates; greedily accept pairs with a gene unused by this and earlier instances, an unused disease, and no guard clash with accepted queries; negatives sampled from sorted pools; stop at 75
protocol.qrels: score=1 for the single gold per query
protocol.metric: hit@1 = recall@1 over all 300 docs (random ranking: 1/300); the 4 docs sharing the query's gene or disease give within-group chance 0.25
